name: Jininese Weapon Mastery
text:
**Jininese Weapon Mastery**: The elves of Jinin are proficient with many of the weapons of the Dragon Empires. Elves with this racial trait are proficient with fighting fans and tonfa, and they treat katanas, kusarigamas, and wakizashis as martial weapons.

This replaces weapon familiarity.
